question: ‘Six Machine: I Don't Like Cricket ... I Love It’ is a book written by:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chris Gayle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book “**Six Machine: I Don’t Like Cricket… I Love It**” is an **autobiography** written by the West Indies cricketer **Chris Gayle.**
 
• The book’s title, **“Six Machine”**, aptly captures Chris Gayle’s explosive batting style.
 
• The subtitle, **“I Don’t Like Cricket… I Love It”**, reflects his passion for the game. Cricket isn’t just a sport for Gayle; it’s an integral part of his life.
 
• Known for his ability to hit massive sixes effortlessly, Gayle has become synonymous with **power-hitting** in cricket.
